messages:
Alex: FYI I ran a small 1% canary for model v3.2-int4 on the rwd-nlg route. Quick summary: big latency + cost wins but a measurable QoL delta on a couple slices. Posting raw smoke numbers below.

Marta: thanks — can you drop the slice breakdown?

Alex: sure. raw numbers from 2k sample split by slice: 
```
slice | baseline_RL | v3.2-int4_RL | delta_pct
long-doc | 0.72 | 0.69 | -4.2%
short | 0.81 | 0.80 | -1.2%
qa | 0.68 | 0.64 | -5.9%
chat-instr | 0.75 | 0.74 | -1.3%
```

Alex: perf/cost side: p50 latency -12%, p95 -18%; token cost estimate down ~32% on our cost model (NVidia A100 baseline -> int4 kernel changes).

Ciara: do we know whether the QA slice drop is hallucination or factuality loss? also which quant backend did you use? :eyes:

Alex: used Hybrid per-channel int4 (NF4-like), custom outlier clamp in the dequant step. Quick grep of mismatch types shows more incorrect span completions on QA (short factual items) — likely reduced representational precision rather than decoding bias.

Dong: can we reproduce locally with the exact same quant config? I want to run targeted eval with the top 500 QA prompts.

Alex: yes, I'll push the quant config + seed to the model repo. snippet: 
```
quant_backend: hybrid_pchan_int4
outlier_clamp: true
kv_dtype: float16
seed: 42
batching: continuous
```

Marta: from a rollout-gates perspective, I propose we don't advance past 1% until QA slice delta < 3% or we have human eval confirming acceptability. For automated fallback thresholds I suggest a multimetric rule: if any critical slice shows >2.0% RL drop OR hallucination_rate increases by >1.5% absolute then auto-fallback. Thoughts?

Ciara: I'd add a min-sample floor (so small noisy windows don't flip the circuit). maybe min_samples=2000 per slice and only evaluate after 30m aggregation window.

Dong: Also capture user_reject_rate and BLEU as secondary signals. Some artifacts show up in BLEU even when RL is stable.

Alex: agree. Proposed auto-fallback config: 
```
auto_fallback:
  min_samples: 2000
  window: 30m
  triggers:
    - metric: rouge_l_delta_pct
      threshold: -2.0
    - metric: hallucination_rate_delta_abs
      threshold: 0.015
    - metric: user_reject_delta_pct
      threshold: 1.0
```

deploy-bot: Canary summary (v3.2-int4) — traffic 1% for 1.5h, samples=6000, alerts=none, auto-fallback_status=not_triggered.

Marta: ok, action items: Alex -> run targeted 10k QA sweep + human pass on top-100 failing samples; Dong -> reproduce quant locally and run unit eval; Ciara -> add min_samples and 30m window into the gate config; I'll hold canary at 1% until we have those.

Ciara: small suggestion — we should also track a weighted composite that penalizes hallucinations x2 relative to RL delta for auto decisions. reduces false accepts.

Alex: good call. I'll prototype composite score and run an ablation tomorrow.

Marta: sounds good. If the targeted QA human pass shows <2% high-severity factual errors and the composite score is within tolerance, we can move to 5% and re-evaluate.

Dong: ping me when the quant config lands.

Alex: pushed quant config + eval harness link: https://internal/redwood/models/v3.2-int4/eval — starting 10k QA sweep now.

Marta: thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical rollout log. :white_check_mark:
